Hello sensei! Nice to meet you. 
May I make a request?

✨️Characters
[1] Ceres
- 26 //male // 165cm
- mimic
- character that struggles with its identity
- Appears friendly and docile to blend in, but easily gets defensive and often resorts to rude remarks and threats when cornered
- One eye pink/yellow (like a sunset) to resemble Umbriel. The other eye orange.

[2] Umbriel
- 30 //male // 180cm
- half human, half mimic
- playful and charming, but can be pushing past personal boundaries of other people. Smiles a lot when being with Ceres.
- One eye is black, the other eye is pink/yellow (resembling a sunset). Please refer to the outdated picrew for reference.

- highly unstable individuals who are codependent to each other.
- has an emotional and physical reliance towards each other
- both are very possessive

https://www.deviantart.com/stash/21893pslcels
https://toyhou.se/32620413.umbriel/gallery?key=9x7eaDmyoSTF9J3
